verdicts.reason: A just shrinks the square layout into the middle of the banner. Big dead bands sit on both sides, and the SOLSTICE wordmark, the can label and the body copy are tiny and close to unreadable, so it doesn't suit the wide format. B rearranges into text on the left and the can on the right, which fits the shape, but it's flawed: the text panel runs off the left edge of the canvas, the logo sits on the panel's top edge, the oversized CTA nearly touches the panel edge and competes with the headline, and the copy is cramped while the right side has slack.

A is the left/right rearrangement and has the same flaws as before: the text panel is cut off at the left canvas edge, the logo overlaps the panel's top edge, and the CTA is too heavy and jammed against the panel edge. Even so, the headline is large and readable and the can is a strong focal point. B is a scaled-down copy of the square layout with wide empty sides, a tiny logo and can label, and small body and CTA text, so it reads as shrunk rather than redesigned.
